sources.passage:
Samsung R & D Institute Delhi | SDE 1 | Oct 2024  [Offer]
Samsung R & D Delhi visited our campus to hire for SDE 1 roles.
Eligiblity Criteria - CS / EE / Rest branches (if minor in CS)
Location - Noida

Process:
1. Coding Test
2. Technical Interview
3. HR Round

**1. Coding Test**
		There was only one question to be solved in 4 hours. It was conducted on their own platform. 
		Difficulty was medium - hard. 
		
		Given two numbers A and S. We need to find all the numbers whose digit sum is S and less than equal A. A is   between 1 to 10 power 100. I solved it using DP.
		
		50 students appeared for the test and only 11 could clear it.
	
**2. Technical Interview**
			It started with my introduction and then about my internship experience. Then project discussion started for around 25 - 30 minutes. He asked me various questions about my project, why this, what will happen if etc. So complete knowledge of project is must. He then gave me a DSA question. There was an array of sorted strings, we need to find a given string is present in it or not. First is the brute force checking all the strings O(mn). Then he asked me to optimize it. I used binary search to optimize it O(m logn). He was satisified with my approach and code. Out of 11, 6 students were able to clear this round.
			
**3. HR Round**
			Very easy round lasted for around 15 mins. Behavioural questions like why samsung, family background, college life, academic journey were asked.
			


Result - All 6 students recieved the offer.
	If you have reached HR Round, then you are 90% selected.

reported.text: Given up to 1e5 numbers, you may chain a[i] to a[j] (i<j) if the last digit of the first equals the first digit of the next. A valid result starts and ends with the same digit; return the maximum total length.

sources.passage:
Samsung Pre Employment test (Samsung R&D Institute India - Delhi)
Went for Samsung Pre Employment test.
Test time was 10:30 AM - 2:30 PM
I have to visit Samsung R&D Institute India – Delhi | SRI-Delhi for this test.

1 DSA question asked.
Question = connect numbers
You are given an array of numbers A = [a0, a1, a2, a3, .... , aN]
You can connect a number a[i] with a[j] where i < j.
To connect 2 numbers the last digit of first number should be equal to first digit of second number. (refer to below examples).
A valid number is if the number first digit is same as last digit.
Find the length of max number which is valid.
1<= N <= 100,000
1 <= a[i] <= 10^9

example 1 : [14, 123, 323, 321, 431, 53635]
output = 9
explanation : valid numbers are = 14431 after joining a0 with a4, 123321 (a1 with a3), 123323321 (a1, a2, a3)
example 2 : [12, 13, 14, 15]
output = 0
example 3 = [14, 13, 22, 19]
output = 2
explanation : 22 is the valid number as first digit of number is same as last digit of number.
